curiosity.title: Ancient Hon Chuong Cham Tower in De Gi, Vietnam
curiosity.summary: Deep within the rugged heights of De Gi in Phu Cat lies one of the most obscure and isolated ancient architectural puzzles in Vietnam. Hon Chuong Tower is a tiny, solitary Cham ruin standing defiantly atop a massive rocky outcrop at an altitude of 779 meters. Both its exact chronology and original purpose remain shrouded in unanswered questions, adding to its deep aura of mystery.
